messages:
maya: Heads-up: nightly-db-sync (cron job id db-sync-prod) failed at 03:05 UTC with intermittent auth errors to storage. CI dashboard shows related e2e build red. Logs show `AuthError: token refresh failed (403)` on multiple replicas.

alex: Copy — can you paste the last 10 lines of the job log?

maya: ```
2024-04-22T03:05:12Z ERROR AuthError: token refresh failed (403) - key rotation mismatch
2024-04-22T03:05:12Z WARN retrying (1/3)
2024-04-22T03:05:14Z ERROR AuthError: token refresh failed (403)
2024-04-22T03:05:16Z INFO backoff 2s
```

pat: Did the key-rotation job run overnight? I noticed a KMS deploy at ~02:50.

zara: I kicked the key rotation canary earlier. @oncall-john can you confirm KMS status for prod cluster?

oncall-john: KMS looks healthy, no deprecations. I see a new key at 02:49:55, but two nodes show service-account token cache not warmed — likely race during rotation.

ci-bot: Build #4821 for infra/e2e-flaky is red. Failure details: https://ci.internal/4821

alex: Ok. Plan: patch a token-cache warmup (short init) and rerun the nightly + CI job. @maya can you trigger a rerun? If it still flakes, we'll bisect commits touching auth lib.

maya: Rerun scheduled: `./tools/cron-rerun --job db-sync-prod --reason auth-403 --force` — started 03:12 UTC.

maya: Rerun finished 03:19 UTC — two of three replicas succeeded, one still hit 403. Collecting full logs and will open bisect if it persists.

pat: If it keeps failing, short-term mitigation: add a canary flag to skip KMS rotation for this job until we fix warmup. Also add a small retry with exponential backoff in the job.

zara: I'll add a cache-warmup step before the job starts and a metric for token-refresh failures so we can alert quicker.

oncall-john: Created incident stub INC-2024-04-22 and tagged infra + ml-systems. Post logs there and I'll page SRE if error rate > 5%.

maya: Logs posted: https://logs.internal/trace/abc123 — last error stack points to `auth/refresh.py:42`.

alex: Thanks. If no objections, I can start a bisect on auth package commits from the last 12 hours. Need someone to run a local reproducer.

pat: I can take the bisect and run the local repro. Assigning to me.

maya: Assigned to @pat. I'll update the CI rerun status in ~15m.

ci-bot: Re-run #4822 triggered by @maya.

oncall-john: Monitoring now. Pushing a slack alert to #eng-infra-pager if failures > 3 in 10m :rotating_light:
